items.title: Snooky Young and Gerald Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: I replaced Buck Clayton. Buck Clayton had to have his tonsils out... I went in the band for a month and replaced Buck and so when Buck came back I went on back home.

ctx.x: You spent two or three periods with Basie, right? One of which was fairly long.

Well the first time I went in Basie’s band was right out of Lunceford’s band. I replaced Buck Clayton. Buck Clayton had to have his tonsils out. I had left Lunceford and I was in my home town just in between whatever might happen. And so they needed a trumpet player to replace Buck so I went in the band for a month and replaced Buck and so when Buck came back I went on back home.
